PLAN 04 | A BLACK MASS ENTERS THE HARBOR

DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES

{{CHAR_SHIP_CREW}}

LOCATION REFERENCES

{{LOC_HARBOR_APPROACH}}  {{LOC_WORKING_QUAY}}

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_ZAHHAK_SHIP}}  {{PROP_MERCHANT_BOATS}}

DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

Full night. Sparse cold practical lights from the port skim an immense black engineered hull. Small recessed ship lights reveal functional edges, railings and structural serpent motifs. The ship remains darker than its surroundings; its outline is readable against the faint sky.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

Zahhak's dedicated ship approaches the harbor at slow docking speed. Ordinary merchant vessels remain much smaller beside the quay. Preserve the ship reference exactly, including snake-headed details and advanced structural design.


PLAN 04 | SHOTS

SHOT 04-01 | 0s–3s | 3 SECONDS

12mm extreme wide from the shore, close to water height. The immense black ship advances slowly from the harbor entrance toward the quay. Let the bow progressively obscure distant port lamps. Small merchant craft and dock structures provide scale. Camera remains nearly fixed; hull displacement moves water in the foreground.

SHOT 04-02 | 3s–11s | 8 SECONDS

18mm very low angle from the quay beside the approaching hull. The bow and flank extend beyond the top and side of the frame. Track slowly along the quay for one meter as recessed lights and snake-shaped structural details pass overhead. Small masked crew members work at the upper rail. Keep the immense flank moving across the frame.

SHOT 04-03 | 11s–15s | 4 SECONDS

24mm from a new quay station directly below the upper command landing, sharply looking upward. Recessed deck lights reveal small masked crew against the immense black engineered structure. Tilt slowly up from a snake-headed structural brace to the landing. No dragon heads. Prepare the elevated authority without bringing Zahhak down to the quay.

END STATE AND EDIT

The ship has reached docking position. A deliberate short ellipse may complete mooring before the next block. Keep ship design, night exposure and elevated landing consistent.

SOUND

Heavy low machinery, displaced water, hull creaks and metal tension. Keep the machinery physically localized to the ship, not a musical drone.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

END PROMPT
